test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Go back over the same route that one has just taken
solution: The correct answer is '**Retrace**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Retrace**'. • It means 'to repeat a past journey, series of events, etc. [(ठीक उसी रास्‍ते) लौटना, पिछली बातों को दोहराना, आदि]' • *Example: If you **retrace** your steps, you might see where you dropped the ticket.* **Correct Answer:__** *Retrace.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Detour**: a longer route from one place to another that you take in order to avoid something/somebody or in order to see or do something. (किसी चीज़ से बचने के लिए लम्बे रास्ते का अनुसरण, घुमावदार या चक्‍करदार रास्‍ता) • **Return**: to come or go back to a place. (कहीं पहुँचना या लौटना) • **Reroute**: send by or along a different route. (किसी भिन्न मार्ग से या उसके साथ भेजें) 26c:Tc2e, The correct answer is '**Assess**'.
